info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Trade Banking Notional Pooling-spec
info.description: The Trade Banking Notional Pooling API enables financial institutions to streamline their liquidity management by facilitating the creation of notional pooling arrangements. This API allows users to define and manage their trade banking notional pooling specifications, ensuring optimal utilization of funds across multiple accounts. Common consumers include treasury departments and financial analysts looking to optimize cash flow and inter-company financing. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency in managing capital resources and improve overall financial performance.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a Notional Pooling request for their trade banking needs. It facilitates centralized cash management by pooling balances across multiple accounts, optimizing the cash position of a business.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating a notional pooling operation in trade banking. This operation allows for the aggregation of balances across multiple accounts to optimize liquidity management and minimize borrowing costs.

201.description: Resource created successfully, reflecting the new notional pooling entry.
